company.name: GovernGPT
company.shortDescription: GovernGPT is an AI company that reviews marketing compliance, and understanding financial regulations.
company.description: GovernGPT develops artificial intelligence tools for reviewing marketing materials in the context of financial sector regulations. Its platform is designed to interpret compliance frameworks such as those from the SEC and FINRA, providing automated review functions for marketing and sales content. The company’s services are intended to support investment management firms by identifying regulatory risks and helping streamline compliance workflows.
